description: Curated public-reference metadata. URLs are recorded, not fetched or verified by the toolkit.

sources.title: Motorola XT2135-2 Declaration of Conformity
sources.supports: Moto G60 model XT2135-2 and type MC38C
sources.limitations: Does not establish SoC, board revision, UEFI, or XNU support.

sources.title: Moto Common Motorola target index
sources.supports: Lists hanoip for the Moto G40 Fusion / Moto G60 family; archived index records the target as dropped.
sources.limitations: Does not establish exact XT2135-2 board equivalence or current support.

sources.title: Motorola kernel-msm issue 559
sources.supports: Motorola contributor points to a published source release for an XT2135-2 build.
sources.limitations: Does not prove the source is sufficient to boot XNU.

sources.title: Android device-tree overlay documentation

sources.limitations: Does not establish the exact Moto G60 device-tree contents.

sources.title: Apple XNU source repository

sources.limitations: Does not provide a ready-made third-party Moto G60 platform port.

sources.title: Apple distribution-iOS ios-260 source tree
sources.supports: Material supplied for research under its own repository and file licenses.
sources.limitations: Does not represent a complete, installable iOS 26 image for Moto G60.

sources.title: HakiOS reference project
sources.supports: An independent example of a layered XNU research repository.
sources.limitations: Does not prove Moto G60 support and is not code to copy without license review.

sources.title: Motorola HANOIP Android 12 kernel source release
sources.supports: Motorola issue #559 ties XT2135-2 Moto G60 firmware build S2RIS32.32-20-9-9-2-1 to a Motorola-published HANOIP Android 12 kernel tag. Tagged tree contains ARM64 HANOIP/SDMMAGPIE kernel configuration and device-tree overlays.
sources.limitations: Does not prove all XT2135-2 variants share identical hardware, identify every silicon detail, establish EFI/boot-chain behavior, or demonstrate XNU support. Inspect individual file licenses before reuse.

sources.title: Motorola kernel-msm Hanoip Android 12 source release
sources.supports: Motorola contributor links this tag from issue #559, whose request identifies the XT2135-2 HANOIP RETEU Android 12 build. The tag contains Hanoip-specific ARM64 device-tree overlays and a Hanoip kernel configuration fragment; the SDMMAGPIE DTS identifies the Qualcomm platform and ARMv8 CPU nodes.
sources.limitations: Does not prove the exact commercial SoC SKU, individual board revision, UEFI availability, XNU compatibility, or bootability. Per-file license review is required before any source reuse.
